76: - **Chrome Extension Styling**: The Chrome extension side panel MUST adhere strictly to a clean, premium Material-inspired Design style (similar to modern cloud consoles) with light and dark theme options. Interactive elements must use soft box-shadows, modern flat styles, and generous rounded corners (typically 8px to 16px, or rounded pills for buttons) to achieve a modern, premium look.

78: ## System Prompt Guidelines (Concept A, B, and C)
79: All system prompts in the codebase (e.g., in [prompts.ts](file:///d:/backup%20from%20pc%20asus/Documents%20Development/superagent/src/core/prompts.ts)) must be designed and optimized using the following guidelines:

81:   - Remove conversational filler, pronouns, polite phrasing, and redundant verbs.
82:   - Use brief, direct imperative statements.
83: - **Concept B: Markdown Structure**
84:   - Organize rules, context, workflows, and rules under clear Markdown headers (e.g., `# ROLE`, `# CRITICAL RULES`, `# WORKFLOW`).
